node.statement: Under the renamed constants from node 1.6.1.1.1 and e<=e_0, one has e<=e_rc. Apply lem-compcb-row-column-product-CONTRACT to the admissible pair Y=X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}: ||Co_Q(X^dagger X)-X^dagger X||<=C_rc*e*||X||_{n,1}^2<=C*e*r^2, because r=||X||_{n,1} and C>=C_rc. By validated node 1.2, Co_Q(X^dagger X)=X^dagger dot X=h*u_Q. Since h>=0, a=||u_Q||, and b=||X^dagger X||, absolute homogeneity gives ||h*u_Q||=h*a, and the reverse triangle inequality yields abs(h*a-b)<=||h*u_Q-X^dagger X||<=C*e*r^2.
